narrative: Trump signed the AI order June 2, tasking CISA with federal-civilian hardening and directing designation of covered frontier models, and analysts frame it as the executive-branch counterpart to the congressional Great American AI Act debate. That paired executive-action-plus-legislative-track shape is the coupled structure the prediction anticipated, even if the instrument lands as a cyber order.
remaining_gap: The signed order is a strictly voluntary cyber instrument barring preclearance, not the Frontier Model Review Board with a 30-day technical-review track; the House resolution has not cleared markup.
